commit_note: git rev-parse HEAD at run time. studies/metaharness/analysis/recall_pilot.py was not committed yet when it ran; it is committed together with this folder, unchanged since the run.
machine: laptop (macOS, BSD grep); past.dev called over the network

board.what: full dump of the team board (270 items, 67 score rows, 182 messages); the 20 questions are drawn from its score rows (MATH-500 and hard328, seed 0, one per configuration)
board.source: made with `uv run tools/board.py`; not in git

traces.what: local copy of every uploaded agent transcript of the team: 271 .jsonl files, 446 MB, 3 people

past_dev_memory.what: the team's shared memory on past.dev, live at run time (not frozen): POST /recall through tools/past.py, maxTokens 2000, key and identity from ~/.past/config.json
past_dev_memory.note: the memory changes as agents post, so recall tokens and result counts differ between runs

cost: 20 POST /recall calls, read-only: 20 past.dev credits at 0.0003 USD = 0.006 USD (credit price from the script's docstring; not checked against past.dev's usage log). No GPU, no model call.
not_reproducible_exactly: grep_words: the script takes the two longest words of the question; words of equal length are ordered by Python's set order, which changes with the process's hash seed (PYTHONHASHSEED was not set). The words used are in each row of rows.jsonl.
seconds: wall time on one laptop, grep time depends on the file cache
